title: TBC laeves model
description: Redo all kinds of leave models of vanilla minecraft
body:
# 📖 What is this?
***
It's a resource pack for leaves in vanilla minecraft. Basically say, it contains 11 kinds of leaves models, each kind of leaves contains two to five random models and several 64×64px textures
![5 kinds of oak leaves](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53760d3c822b27111b866abdaf609cd29ee3591a_0.webp)

# ❗ Note
***
1. There are some render problem while shader is off, so I recommend you to use it with shader on

2. This resource pack is developed based netease version so only contains 1.12, 1.16, 1.18, 1.20 and 1.20.6 version.
